effect: The completed skin is connected to the body’s vessels and nerves, and the chapter goal is complete.
reaction: It is satisfying to see the assembled skin connected to the larger body, though the final result adds little explanation.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the sensory endings was most worthwhile because the explanation brought the skin’s vessels, gland and nerves together and gave each a role.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the sweat gland felt least worthwhile on its own: it was straightforward and the result added no explanation.

surprise.text: The explanation that deeper cells replace those shed at the surface made the barrier feel like a renewing tissue rather than a static covering.

arbitrary.text: No action felt clearly arbitrary; the named slots and picture descriptions gave the fittings a purpose, though some results offered little detail.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it develops a new relationship between body systems. The connections are clear, but the compatible-option menu makes many individual choices predictable.
